server: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/intake-native-omissions.ts: finds each converted layer's derivative by its stored lineage (originalItemId, originalSourceId, originalSha256, originalSourceRevision; newest per layer), reads each layer's locator file in 1 MiB ranges within a 16 MiB request budget, checks a whole read against the kept SHA-256 and written/not-written counts, lists at most 50 omissions per layer (position and reason as the converter stated them) with the layer's total. A file that does not fit is listed in part (scan 'partial', not hash-checked, complete lines only); a layer past the budget keeps counts only ('not_read'); a layer with nothing left out is not read ('none_left_out').

IntakeService.omissions: original item authority through intakeCaseTx + itemContextTx (assertIntakeSource), assertIngestionBinding; refuses a member, a non-root item or a format that is not converted (409 INTAKE_OMISSIONS_NOT_NATIVE). The locator key comes only from stored lineage parsed by NativeDerivativeLineageSchema; no object URL is exposed.
Route GET /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/intake/items/{itemId}/omissions (Cache-Control private, no-store), operation manifest entry batch NO1.
featureCountWords now ends: 'Open the reading of this file to see them listed.'

words.panel_help: What the reader stated about the file, as stored. A reading is a candidate: nothing here is placed on the map, confirmed or recorded in the register.

reading_states.none: No {reader} reading is named for this file.
reading_states.failed: The {reader} reading stopped ({code}); there is no reading to open.
reading_states.stale: This reading is out of date: the file, the case or the reader changed after it ran.
reading_states.queued: The {reader} reading is waiting to start.
reading_states.no_result: The reading finished without an accepted result.

omissions_route_words: No converted layer of this file is kept yet, so nothing is listed as left out.
Every feature of {n} converted layers was written; none was left out.
{n} features of {m} layers were not written. Each stays in the original at the position listed, with the converter's reason; at most 50 are listed per layer.
A long locator file was read only in part, so its list is not checked against the file's SHA-256.
Some layers were not read in this request, as at most 16 MiB of locator files are read at once; only their counts are shown.
These are candidates from the converter; nothing here is placed, confirmed or recorded.
words.layer_line: {written} written, {notWritten} not written · nothing left out | all listed | the first {listed} of {notWritten} listed | {listed} listed from the start of its locator file, not checked against its SHA-256 | not listed in this read; counts only
words.item_reason_after: ... A feature not written is not in that layer's GeoJSON; the stored locator file kept beside that GeoJSON names its position in the original and why. Open the reading of this file to see them listed.

checked_no_issue: apps/studio/src/features/intake/native/NativeReading.tsx: --ui-* tokens only through the existing IfcStructure.module.css; no new CSS.
Every value is read from the reader's status record or the omissions record; no sample content.
Null stays distinct: 'Not stated (stored as null)', never blank or 0; unread layers say so in words.
Identifiers (SHA-256, positions) in ul-mono; sentence case; one soft button per item, no primary button added.

limits_and_open_points: The native reader's full artifact (/native route) is not offered; the panel shows the status route's summary fields as stored. A download button through the existing /native route can be added if wanted.
A partial locator read is listed without a SHA-256 check (said in words); only files up to 16 MiB per request are checked whole.
A derivative whose lineage merge failed after its receipt (WD1/SH1 known limit) is not found and so not listed.
Positions are shown with the converter's positionKind (fid, sequence, placemark_sequence, cityobject_pointer, element_ordinal) as stated; no officer-facing translation of those kinds.
rehearsal_should_check: Build the combined image and enrol a DXF, CityJSON, CityGML, glTF/GLB and OBJ in one batch: each row shows 'Open the reading'; opening it shows the reader summary from GET .../{reader}/jobs/{jobId} with status completed, and 'waiting'/'being read' words while queued or running.

Enrol a GeoPackage (and a shapefile ZIP, a loose .shp set and a KML) with at least one refused row: after conversion the parent row offers 'Open the reading'; 'Features not written' lists positions and reasons matching the locator file in object storage; counts match the item's reason words.
A layer with more than 50 refused rows lists 50 and states the total; a locator file over 16 MiB shows the partial words.
From another operator subject or another case the omissions route answers 403/404 and reads no object; a GeoJSON item answers 409.
Network tab: only /api/v1/ingestion/... routes are called; no object-store URL reaches the browser; responses carry Cache-Control private, no-store.
Keyboard and 200% zoom on the panel; nothing on the panel places, confirms or records.
